The experimental application-neutral workflow, runtime, capability,
connection, skill, deliverable, artifact, and host-state APIs are unavailable
in Tempest 0.2. Retained symbols fail immediately with class
`tempest_generic_kernel_cutover_error`. There is no compatibility or migration
layer.

Use `tempest_run()` for scripted STORM research and `tempest_session()` for
interactive Co-STORM research. Fixed scientific transformations carry dsprrr
program identity, and open-ended agent work carries Deputy execution identity.
Those identities support correlation and audit joins only; they do not claim
causal content provenance.

This non-runnable vignette remains only as deletion inventory until T8 removes
the generic kernel physically. It is intentionally excluded from the pkgdown
article navigation.
